clues: Its chief executive remarked that AI mode does not drive traffic, not for us and not to anybody, as far as I know.
It saw inbound search referrals plunge by more than one million visits per week on average during October 2026.
It previously inked an AI data licensing deal with Google valued at $60 million annually and held active discussions with OpenAI.
Logged-in and app users drive over 80% of its revenue, helping push its U.S. average revenue per daily active user up 53% to $13.82.
To thwart unauthorized automated scraping of its archives, it announced plans to curb logged-out browsing in foreign markets.
Led by Steve Huffman, this popular online forum site is testing mandatory logins for international visitors arriving from search.
